highlights: The Baseus HDMI cable transmits 4K resolution, which is up to four times the size of regular HD, providing incredible quality even in the smallest details.

The cable is equipped with stylish and extremely robust plugs, which are resistant to oxidation and abrasion. An additional PVC coating provides protection, flexibility, and durability, and with a reinforced connection point between the cable and the plug, the cable is resistant to the most common mechanical damage found in cables.
The cable is made of high-quality components, and intelligent chips and circuits will take care of the safety and protection of your equipment.

The cable has two HDMI interfaces in 2.0 standard – this standard increases cable throughput up to 18 Gb/s. This means you don’t have to worry about image delays, and the cable guarantees a stable, high-quality connection.
The cable does not require any special software, drivers, or external power supply.
